attributes.storage_instructions: Store Cilidin T Tablet in a cool and dry place, protected from direct sunlight, moisture and heat., Keep it away from children and pets. Do not use expired medicines., Discard any unused medicine properly, do not flush in the toilet or throw it into the drain.
